instruction: Disable VLC's global play/pause hotkey to prevent conflicts with shortcuts in other applications.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to disable the global play/pause hotkey (global-key-play-pause should be empty in vlcrc). The evaluator uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric to verify the hotkey is disabled (value should be 0). Similar complexity to original task - both involve modifying a single VLC hotkey/UI setting.
